title: Everything But the Ends
narrative: The first crate is the decoy and the last is the seal. The Quartermaster wants everything BETWEEN them — in one clean slice.
instructions:
The System provides `supplies`, a list of crates. Do not assign it yourself.

Store a new list in `middle` holding everything EXCEPT the first and last crate.

- With `["a", "b", "c", "d"]`, `middle` is `["b", "c"]`.
- If there is nothing in between, `middle` is the empty list `[]`.

Use a single slice.
starting_code:
# `supplies` is provided by the System (do not reassign it).
# Keep everything EXCEPT the first and last crate, using one slice.

middle =
hints: Start the slice at slot 1 to drop the first crate.
End the slice at -1 to drop the last crate (the end bound is not included).
When the list has 0, 1, or 2 crates, [1:-1] is simply empty — which is exactly what you want.
